Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The primary biological variable is the use of rapalog to trigger protein trans-splicing. While the study involves genetic constructs (CAGE systems), the proteomics comparison axis is the rapalog-induced state versus the DMSO control. Mapping is kept at the parent level for chemical_or_drug as rapalog acts as a chemical trigger for a synthetic biology system rather than a standard inhibitor or activator of a native protein.
